notes:
JAPANESE SWEETS ({和菓子|わがし}):
{餡子|あんこ} is a fundamental ingredient in Japanese confections.

TYPES OF {餡子|あんこ}:
- ⟦こしあん→こしあん：20791_koshian⟧ - smooth bean paste (strained)
- つぶあん - chunky bean paste (with visible beans)
- {白|しろ}あん - white bean paste (from white beans)

SWEETS WITH {餡子|あんこ}:
- ⟦{大福|だいふく}→大福：12173_daifuku⟧ - rice cake with bean paste filling
- ⟦{饅頭|まんじゅう}→饅頭：05000_manjuu⟧ - steamed bun with bean paste
- ⟦{羊羹|ようかん}→羊羹：05002_youkan⟧ - sweet bean jelly
- ⟦{鯛焼|たいや}き→鯛焼き：10363_taiyaki⟧ - fish-shaped cake with bean paste
- ⟦どら{焼|や}き→どら焼き：10393_dorayaki⟧ - dorayaki (two pancakes with bean paste)
- ⟦{餅|もち}→餅：03900_mochi⟧ - mochi with bean paste
- ⟦おはぎ→おはぎ：29365_ohagi⟧/{萩|はぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{餅|もち}→餅：03900_mochi⟧ - rice ball covered with bean paste

VARIANT READINGS:
- あんこ (colloquial)
- あん (shortened form)
- ⟦{餡|あん}→餡：10220_an⟧ (written form)

NOTE: The ⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧ in {餡子|あんこ} is a diminutive suffix.
